answer: Reaching the tide of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the jetty of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the quill re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, converted to a slow vesting stream. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
